kpis.description_fr: Ratio CET1 fully-loaded : capital base. Buffer confortable vs requirement BCE ~9%, excess capital pour retours actionnaires.
kpis.description_en: Fully-loaded CET1 ratio: capital base. Comfortable buffer vs ECB requirement ~9%, excess capital for shareholder returns.

kpis.description_fr: NII : Banco BPM bénéficie taux ECB hausse 2022-2024. Sensibilité rate cycle élevée.
kpis.description_en: NII: Banco BPM benefits from 2022-2024 ECB rate hikes. High rate cycle sensitivity.

kpis.description_fr: Coût du risque (provisions / loans). Amélioration progressive, NPL ratio descendant.
kpis.description_en: Cost of risk (provisions / loans). Progressive improvement, NPL ratio decreasing.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio NPL : crédits en défaut / total. KPI asset quality banque italienne, gross descend bien.
kpis.description_en: NPL ratio: defaulted loans / total. Italian bank asset quality KPI, gross trending down well.

kpis.description_fr: RoTE : KPI rentabilité actionnaires, doublé en 4 ans suite recovery banque italienne post-COVID.
kpis.description_en: RoTE: shareholder return KPI, doubled in 4 years post-COVID Italian bank recovery.

kpis_story.description_fr: Novembre 2024 : UniCredit lance OPA hostile sur Banco BPM (€10.1Md, échange actions). Refus du board BAMI, intervention government italien. Issue en jeu Q1-Q2 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: November 2024: UniCredit launches hostile takeover bid on Banco BPM (€10.1B, share exchange). BAMI board refusal, Italian government intervention. Outcome at stake Q1-Q2 2025.
